title: K-pop Award Shows True or False
description: Ten true or false statements about the K-pop award shows themselves: who runs MAMA, Melon, Golden Disc and Seoul Music Awards, and where.

questions.question: The awards show now known as the MAMA Awards was first held in 1999.
questions.fun_fact: The show took the Mnet Asian Music Awards name in 2009 as it set its sights beyond Korea, then shortened its brand to the MAMA Awards in 2022.

questions.question: The first MAMA ceremony held outside South Korea took place in Singapore in 2010.
questions.fun_fact: The 2010 edition went to Macau, at the Cotai Arena of The Venetian Macao. Singapore hosted in 2011, then Hong Kong from 2012 to 2017.

questions.question: The Melon Music Awards are presented by CJ ENM, the company behind the Mnet channel.
questions.fun_fact: They are held by Kakao Entertainment through its streaming service Melon, whose digital data counts alongside online votes and judges.

questions.question: The Golden Disc Awards were first held in 1986, under the name Korea Visual and Records Grand Prize Award.
questions.fun_fact: The ceremony took the name Golden Disk Awards in 2001, and the spelling changed to Golden Disc in 2015.

questions.question: The Seoul Music Awards are presented by the sports daily Ilgan Sports.
questions.fun_fact: The Seoul Music Awards, or Seoul Gayo Daesang in Korean, are presented by the newspaper Sports Seoul and have aired on KBS N since 2013.

questions.question: The Circle Chart Music Awards used the name Gaon Chart Music Awards until the chart was rebranded in 2022.
questions.fun_fact: The awards are presented by the Korea Music Content Association, and the first ceremony took place in Seoul on February 22, 2012.

questions.question: The 40th Golden Disc Awards were held at the Taipei Dome in January 2026.
questions.fun_fact: Hosted by Sung Si-kyung and Moon Ga-young on January 10, 2026, the ceremony honored Korean music released from early November 2024 to early November 2025.

questions.question: The 2023 MAMA Awards took place at the Kyocera Dome in Osaka.
questions.fun_fact: The 2023 show ran over two nights at the Tokyo Dome. The Kyocera Dome in Osaka hosted in 2022 and 2024 and was chosen again for the November 2026 edition.

questions.question: The Seoul Music Awards were held outside South Korea for the first time in January 2024, in Bangkok.
questions.fun_fact: The 33rd ceremony took place at Rajamangala Stadium. The next two editions moved to June, at Inspire Arena in Incheon.

questions.question: The 2023 and 2024 Melon Music Awards were both held at the Gocheok Sky Dome in Seoul.
questions.fun_fact: Both ceremonies took place at Inspire Arena in Incheon. The show returned to the Gocheok Sky Dome for its December 2025 edition.

title: IVE: The SWITCH to EMPATHY Era
description: IVE in 2024 and 2025: Heya and Will, Rebel Heart and Attitude, Supernova Love, XOXZ, the world tour and Lollapalooza.

questions.question: What does the Korean title of IVE's April 2024 single Heya mean?
questions.fun_fact: Described as a hip hop song in F minor, Heya draws its lyrics from a folk tale and climbed to No. 2 on the Circle Digital Chart.

questions.question: Will, a Japanese song IVE released on April 12, 2024, was the new opening theme of which anime series?
questions.fun_fact: The opening video came out on Pokémon's official YouTube channel, and IVE's second Japanese EP, Alive, followed on August 28, 2024.

questions.question: Which IVE member wrote the lyrics of Blue Heart, a track on the 2024 EP Ive Switch?
questions.fun_fact: Blue Heart is the third of the six tracks on Ive Switch, an EP that peaked at No. 2 on the Circle Album Chart.

questions.question: IVE's first world tour, Show What I Have, ended in September 2024 with two shows at which venue?
questions.fun_fact: The tour opened in Seoul on October 7, 2023 and grew to 37 concerts across Asia, North America, Europe, Latin America and Oceania.

questions.question: Supernova Love, IVE's November 2024 single with David Guetta, samples a piece by which Japanese composer?
questions.fun_fact: The sampled piece is Merry Christmas, Mr. Lawrence. IVE first teased the song during encores of their world tour shows in Japan.

questions.question: Which Ive Empathy single came out first, on January 13, 2025, and went on to top the Circle Digital Chart?
questions.fun_fact: It became IVE's fifth song to achieve a perfect all-kill on Korean charts and collected eleven first places on music shows.

questions.question: Attitude, the second single from Ive Empathy, interpolates which Suzanne Vega song?
questions.fun_fact: Released with the EP on February 3, 2025, Attitude peaked at No. 7 on the Circle Digital Chart and won on M Countdown, Inkigayo and Show! Music Core.

questions.question: At which 2025 ceremony did IVE's Rebel Heart win the Song of the Year daesang?
questions.fun_fact: The 10th Asia Artist Awards took place on December 6, 2025 at the National Stadium in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

questions.question: After a first Lollapalooza in Chicago in 2024, IVE played which two editions of the festival in July 2025?
questions.fun_fact: On July 12, 2025, IVE became the first K-pop girl group to perform at Lollapalooza Berlin, then played the Paris edition on July 20.

questions.question: What was the lead single of Ive Secret, the EP IVE released on August 25, 2025?
questions.fun_fact: Ive Secret topped the Circle Album Chart, making it the group's seventh No. 1 album and sixth million-seller.

title: K-pop Groups and Their First Wins
description: Which song gave TVXQ, Apink, EXO, TWICE, ITZY or TWS their first music show win, and on which show? Ten hard questions.

questions.question: TVXQ won their first music show award on Inkigayo in March 2004. Which song won it?
questions.fun_fact: The win came on March 28, 2004, and Hug went on to stay on the MIAK monthly chart for ten consecutive months.

questions.question: Beast, the group now called Highlight, got their first music show win with Shock in March 2010. On which show?
questions.fun_fact: Shock led their second EP, Shock of the New Era. Later in 2010, the single Breath took first place on KBS's Music Bank.

questions.question: Which song gave Apink their first music show award, on M Countdown in January 2012?
questions.fun_fact: My My came from their second EP, Snow Pink. A month later, Apink won Rookie of the Year at the first Gaon Chart Awards.

questions.question: Which single earned EXO their first music show win, on Music Bank in June 2013?
questions.fun_fact: EXO later won 18 music shows with Call Me Baby (2015), a record for a single song that they held for four years.

questions.question: On February 2, 2016, GFriend won their first music show award on The Show. Which song won it?
questions.fun_fact: Rough closed the group's school concept trilogy after Glass Bead and Me Gustas Tu, and won 15 music show awards in all.

questions.question: Which single gave TWICE their first music program award, on M Countdown in May 2016?
questions.fun_fact: The win came on May 5, 2016, exactly one year after the first episode of Sixteen, the survival show that formed TWICE.

questions.question: Which song gave MAMAMOO their first music show win, on Inkigayo in March 2016?
questions.fun_fact: It was the title track of their first studio album, Melting, and became their first number-one single. It won eight music shows in total.

questions.question: With Dalla Dalla in February 2019, ITZY won their first music show trophy. On which show?
questions.fun_fact: The win set a record at the time as the fastest music show win by a girl group, and Dalla Dalla went on to collect nine trophies.

questions.question: ENHYPEN took their first music show win with Drunk-Dazed in May 2021. On which show?
questions.fun_fact: Drunk-Dazed led their second EP, Border: Carnival, which became the group's first No. 1 on Japan's Oricon Albums Chart.

questions.question: On which show did TWS take their first music show win, with Plot Twist, 23 days after their 2024 debut?
questions.fun_fact: Plot Twist led their debut EP, Sparkling Blue, released on January 22, 2024, the start of what the group labels boyhood pop.

title: NMIXX: From O.O to Blue Valentine
description: Easy questions on NMIXX: Ad Mare, the meaning of their name, the leader, Dice, Party O'Clock, the Fe3O4 series and Blue Valentine.

questions.question: What was the title of NMIXX's debut single album, released on February 22, 2022?
questions.fun_fact: Ad Mare is Latin for to the sea. Besides its lead single, it holds the B-side Tank and instrumental versions of both songs.

questions.question: Which member is the leader of NMIXX?
questions.fun_fact: In her first solo magazine profile, in the June 2025 issue of Marie Claire Korea, Haewon spoke about her role as the group's leader.

questions.question: The N in NMIXX stands for now, new, next and which other idea?
questions.fun_fact: The word mix stands for combination and diversity, so the full name is meant as the best combination for a new era.

questions.question: Which song led NMIXX's second single album, Entwurf, in September 2022?
questions.fun_fact: Entwurf means draft or design in German. It came out seven months after their debut single album.

questions.question: Love Me Like This (2023) was the lead single of NMIXX's first EP. What is that EP called?
questions.fun_fact: Expérgo is Latin for to wake up. Released on March 20, 2023, the EP was preceded by the single Young, Dumb, Stupid.

questions.question: Which K-pop label founder co-wrote and co-composed Party O'Clock, NMIXX's July 2023 single?
questions.fun_fact: Party O'Clock led the single album A Midsummer NMIXX's Dream and was described as a garage-based pop song.

questions.question: Which song led Fe3O4: Break, the EP NMIXX released on January 15, 2024?
questions.fun_fact: Dash was described as a cross between old school hip hop and pop punk, and its music video came out the same day as the EP.

questions.question: Know About Me led which March 2025 EP, the finale of NMIXX's Fe3O4 series?
questions.fun_fact: The EP followed Fe3O4: Break and Fe3O4: Stick Out. Its pre-release single, High Horse, came out on March 4, 2025.

questions.question: In 2025, Blue Valentine gave NMIXX their first number one on which chart?
questions.fun_fact: The song led their first studio album of the same name, released in October 2025, and spent four weeks at the top.

questions.question: In February 2025, NMIXX made a surprise appearance at the Viña del Mar festival. In which country is it held?
questions.fun_fact: It made them the first K-pop group ever to perform at the festival, and they were later announced as headliners of the 2026 edition.

title: K-pop Songs With Numbers
description: From 8282 and 1, 2, 3, 4 to 2 Baddies, 3D and Love 119: ten questions on K-pop songs with a number in the title.

questions.question: Which girl group released the tropical house single 4 Walls in October 2015?
questions.fun_fact: 4 Walls was the title track of f(x)'s fourth studio album and peaked at No. 2 on the Gaon Digital Chart. LDN Noise co-composed it.

questions.question: SHINee's 2016 album 1 of 1 had a 1990s theme. On which retro format did it get a limited edition?
questions.fun_fact: 1 of 1 was SHINee's fifth Korean studio album. Its November 2016 repackage, 1 and 1, was led by Tell Me What to Do.

questions.question: Read aloud, the title of Davichi's 2009 single 8282 sounds like a Korean word. What does that word mean?
questions.fun_fact: 8282 led Davichi in Wonderland, the duo's first EP, which came out in early 2009.

questions.question: 200% was a single from Play, the April 2014 debut album of which K-pop Star 2 winners?
questions.fun_fact: YG's Yang Hyun-suk picked 200% as a single while the duo chose Melted. 200% topped the Gaon Digital Chart for two weeks.

questions.question: Which singer made her debut with the single 1, 2, 3, 4 on October 28, 2012?
questions.fun_fact: She had finished second on the first season of K-pop Star before signing with YG Entertainment, and the song was No. 1 on the monthly Gaon Digital Chart for November 2012.

questions.question: IU's Twenty-Three was the lead single of which 2015 EP?
questions.fun_fact: Released on October 23, 2015, the disco-inspired track topped the Gaon Digital Chart and has sold over 2.5 million downloads in South Korea.

questions.question: NCT 127's 2022 single 2 Baddies has a different Korean title. What does it mean?
questions.fun_fact: 2 Baddies led NCT 127's fourth studio album, also named 2 Baddies, released by SM Entertainment on September 16, 2022.

questions.question: Which American rapper is featured on 3D, Jungkook's single from September 2023?
questions.fun_fact: 3D debuted at No. 5 on the Billboard Hot 100, and a November 2023 remix replaced Harlow with Justin Timberlake.

questions.question: Number One Girl, released in November 2024, was a single from which album?
questions.fun_fact: Rosé said the title refers to her fans, whom she calls her number ones. Bruno Mars is among the song's producers.

questions.question: Which boy group released Love 119 in January 2024?
questions.fun_fact: Love 119 samples Emergency Room, a 2005 song by the band Izi, and peaked at No. 5 on the Circle Digital Chart.
